system_evidence.basisNote: Current persisted evidence bound to this system (DIRECT_SYSTEM + asset-bound, incl. historical). Not an evaluated snapshot; evaluationIds per record give exact membership.
semantics: ABSENT_FACET != ZERO_EVENTS — absence means no typed records persisted, not that nothing happened.
NORMALIZED_RECORD_FACT != VERIFIED_FACT — typed fields are caller-declared source content.
CURRENT_FACET != EVALUATION_SNAPSHOT — evaluationIds give exact membership; facets are current persisted state.
UNCLASSIFIED_RECORD != NO_EVIDENCE — unmarked records exist but carry no typed facet.
